input: Reserve a weekend pottery retreat out of town

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The target weekend date determines availability, pricing, and how urgently the booking needs to happen.
Whether this is for one person or a group affects venue type, room requirements, and total cost.
Knowing how far 'out of town' means — a short drive vs. a flight away — narrows the geographic search significantly.
Budget per person directly filters which retreats are realistic options and whether all-inclusive packages are feasible.
Skill level (beginner vs. experienced) determines whether instruction, open studio time, or a structured curriculum is needed.
Understanding whether the priority is the pottery experience itself, relaxation, social connection, or accommodation quality shapes which retreat is the best fit.
Knowing whether accommodation must be on-site or if nearby lodging is acceptable affects which venues to consider and what needs to be booked separately.

gold.taskTitle: Reserve a weekend pottery retreat out of town
gold.taskDescription: Find and book a weekend pottery retreat at an out-of-town location.

questions.title: Which specific weekend are you targeting for this retreat?
questions.description: Identify the exact dates or a narrow window of dates the user has in mind, which drives availability searches and booking urgency.

questions.title: How many people are attending this retreat?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a solo trip, a pair, or a group, which affects venue capacity, room needs, and total cost.

questions.title: How far from home are you willing to travel?
questions.description: Establish a geographic radius or travel method (short drive, road trip, flight) to narrow down the location search.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for the full retreat?
questions.description: Capture a rough or firm budget figure to filter retreat options by price tier and package type.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with pottery?
questions.description: Determine if the user is a complete beginner, hobbyist, or experienced potter, which shapes the type of instruction or studio format needed.

questions.title: What matters most — the pottery instruction, relaxation, or social experience?
questions.description: Identify the user's primary goal for the retreat to prioritize the right type of venue and program structure.

questions.title: Does accommodation need to be on-site at the pottery venue?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a fully residential retreat or is comfortable booking nearby lodging separately.
